title: Egress Sniff Sheet
one_liner: Paste a router or DNS log export and see which devices talk to the outside world, how much, and when.
headline: Paste your lab's router or DNS export and get devices ranked by outbound traffic, after-hours flags, per-device destination lists, and a one-click network segmentation plan.

episode.title: Can Jensen Huang remain CEO? Inside NVIDIA’s next steps| MOONSHOTS #310

history.summary: A genuinely working, single-page audit tool that maps closely onto the Phone-Home Patrol opportunity: real client-side CSV parsing, correct after-hours detection, a working destination drill-down, and a segmentation plan that names actual flagged devices rather than canned output. Honesty is solid — simulated sample data and the in-browser-only claim are both clearly and accurately labeled, with no fabricated real-world figures. The main gaps are product-logic ones (rank- rather than threshold-based 'high volume' flagging, naive CSV parsing, exact-schema requirement) that limit it as a drop-in tool for messy real exports but don't block publishing.
